name: Image Resizer
summary: Resize PNG, JPEG, or WebP images to exact pixels, fit a box, or scale by percent — in your browser.
description: Drop an image, pick exact size, fit-inside dimensions, or a percentage scale. Lock aspect ratio, choose output format and JPEG quality, then download. Processing stays on your device.

faqs.question: Is my image uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Resize runs entirely in your browser with the Canvas API.

faqs.question: What does Fit box mean?
faqs.answer: The image is scaled to fit inside the max width and height while keeping aspect ratio.

faqs.question: Which formats can I export?
faqs.answer: Keep the source format, or export as JPEG, PNG, or WebP (browser support required).
